purpose: Pursuit behavior trust audit, not biological validation

protocol.factor_rule: Only path, input current, or step duration changes within its sweep.

controls.disconnected: Remove AOTU-to-DNa02 bridges; retain LC10a-to-AOTU edges.
controls.bridge_side_swapped: Keep synapse counts and signs, swap DNa02 destinations.
controls.direct_bearing: No neural graph; same view gate/dead zone and 1.2 rad/s cap, turn rate is signed 1.2 times encoded bearing strength. The direct rule is fixed across all sweeps.

protocol.metric: Mean absolute target bearing over all active frames, including out-of-view frames; lower is better only for centering, not overall biological behavior.
